propositions: Canonical contributor guidance in AGENTS.md and .agents/rules/rebar.md hardcodes a specific bot identity (joeoakhart+bot@navapbc.com) instead of instructing contributors to use their own configured git identity
CONTRIBUTING.md requires real contributor names and emails for DCO sign-off, contradicting hardcoded bot identity guidance in other documentation files

Documentation guidance across AGENTS.md, .agents/rules/rebar.md, and CONTRIBUTING.md must be unified to consistently require contributors to sign off with their own configured git identity, not a third-party identity

A deterministic consistency check must be integrated into make lint to prevent reintroduction of hardcoded personal bot identities in contributor-facing documentation while preserving bot identity references in automation-owned paths (infra/, .github/workflows/, tests/, docs/experiments/)
